name: Calamity King
author: Addicting Games
description:
Endure the Calamity and rise victorious as the Calamity King!

In this chess-themed bullethell, you'll hop, dodge and strike your way across a chess board arena as you endure an endless onslaught of enemies! Each enemy is a different chess piece with unique attacks, so you'll have to learn their patterns and strike when they're vulnerable!

Can you defeat five levels of Calamity and secure your reign?
